summary: Agriculture & Natural Solutions Acquisition Corp (ANSC), a SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing it will not consummate a business combination before the Completion Window expires on August 12, 2026, as the sponsor affiliate will not continue extension payments. The board will cease operations, redeem public Class A shares at the trust account per-share price (including interest, less up to $100,000 for dissolution expenses) within ten business days, then dissolve and liquidate subject to shareholder and board approval. The redemption extinguishes shareholder rights. The company will wind up under Cayman Islands law. Watch for the redemption price relative to ANSC's trading price and the timing of final distributions.
